name: Scent Field
description: The smell of a place, as information with age and direction rather than a line to follow. Sources lay scent at a point with a kind and a strength; each fades on a half-life, faster in rain, and reads stronger at night. A reading at a position returns what is smellable there in one of two modes: nose-down (ground, short range, old trails) or nose-up (air, long range, carried on the wind, bearing bent by it). It never says what a scent means or whether the ground toward it is walkable; it answers what is on the air here, how old, which way. Marking lays the reader's own scent.

implementations.note: Implemented in the consuming application; not verifiable from this repository.

inputs.name: sources
inputs.description: Initial sources: {id, kind, x, z, strength, ageMinutes}. More arrive by input.mark and by other bricks calling lay().

inputs.name: halfLifeMinutes
inputs.description: Minutes for a source's strength to halve in dry weather. Twelve hours by default: a day-old trail reads faint on the ground, not gone.

inputs.name: rainWashRate
inputs.description: Decay multiplier while the weather is rain or storm.

inputs.name: nightBoost
inputs.description: Multiplier on readable strength between dusk and dawn.

inputs.name: groundRange
inputs.description: Nose-down reach in world units: close, old, exact.

inputs.name: airRange
inputs.description: Nose-up reach in world units downwind of a source; upwind reach is a fraction of it.

inputs.name: windSpeed
inputs.description: Wind speed 0..1; moves air scent downwind and shortens upwind reach.

inputs.name: windDirection
inputs.description: Direction the wind blows toward, in radians, 0 along +x.

outputs.name: sources
outputs.description: Live sources with current strength and age.

outputs.name: wind
outputs.description: {speed, direction} as the field currently has them.

outputs.name: mode
outputs.description: The reader's nose mode: ground or air.

outputs.name: smellAt
outputs.description: (x, z, mode?) -> readings [{id, kind, strength, ageMinutes, bearing, distance}], strongest first; bearing from the reader to the source, bent downwind in air mode.

outputs.name: lay
outputs.description: (kind, x, z, strength?) -> id; lays a source and emits world.scentLaid.

provenance: Added 2026-11-09 for the canine survival pack (the-things-that-wake). Catalogue search first: pets.scent_tracker is a companion ability that picks one undiscovered point of interest by tag and reports a bearing to it; presentation.scent_trail_renderer draws that bearing. Neither models smell as a field with age, wind and two reading modes, which is what a game played as the dog needs; this owns the field, and the tracker could read it later. Library-native.
